note: The first evening's one-shots (docs/future/13 section 2.1; docs/17 'A far curlew at dusk'): when the fire is first lit on the first evening (intro:curlew), one curlew call far out over the water. A sound only, not a creature: frogs still sleep on spring day 0. Played through src/audio/keepsake-sounds.js on the creatures bus, quiet, as if from far off. The CC0 take goes in assets/audio/one-shots/intro/ (.ogg and .m4a) with its source in assets/audio/CREDITS.md; until it is there the call is silent and the console says so once. The camp's fire (camp:sound, src/world/camp): strike, the fire steel on its flint; catch, the twigs taking; hiss, rain on a burning fire. Their CC0 takes go in the same folder; until then they are silent.
